parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS cfg FROM agenda.settings

parameters.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('start', b.starts_at, 'end', b.ends_at)), '[]'::jsonb) AS busy FROM agenda.busy(now(), now() + interval '15 days') b
